caveat: No cell verifies exact-plan adoption, member eligibility, prior authorization approval, payment or a medication supply route. REVIEWED means a reviewed public source exists for the payer, line and product; staff must still confirm the member product and the current source version.

statuses.reviewed: REVIEWED — fingerprinted public snapshot or reviewed criteria extract for this payer, line and product; exact-plan adoption still unverified
statuses.stale: STALE — a reviewed record exists but its review window, effective date or version no longer covers the as-of date
statuses.partial: PARTIAL — directory-level reference, policy link, code-list entry or restrictive note without extracted criteria
statuses.live-formulary: LIVE FORMULARY — pharmacy-benefit drug on a line with an exact-plan machine-readable formulary lookup (tier and PA/ST/QL flags at runtime); not member eligibility
statuses.routing-only: ROUTE ONLY — only a PA lookup or submission route is known; no policy content
statuses.missing: MISSING — no record of any kind for this payer, line and service
statuses.n/a: n/a — the coverage line cannot pay for this service type (for example Part D for surgery)
